answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the pulse of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the garden until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the harbor of the next round. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, re-queued for a second panel.
